rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a shop counter where business is conducted.

example.english: I’ll ask at the counter first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 gwai6 toi4 man6 haa5 sin1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when counter means to oppose a person, idea, or proposal.

example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 deoi3 ni1 go3 tai4 ji5

rows.note: Use this when counter means to contradict or argue against what someone has said.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 faan2 bok3 ngo5 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when counter means taking action or responding to a situation or opposing move.

example.english: We need to know how to counter unexpected situations.
example.traditional: 遇到突發情況，我哋要識得應對。
example.jyutping: jyu6 dou3 dat6 faat3 cing4 fong3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sik1 dak1 jing3 deoi3

rows.note: Use this for striking back while being attacked, including a boxing counterpunch.

example.english: I counter immediately when the other side attacks.
example.traditional: 對方一打過嚟，我就即刻反擊。
example.jyutping: deoi3 fong1 jat1 daa2 gwo3 lai4 ngo5 zau6 zik1 hak1 faan2 gik1
